verdict.rationale: The workers-sdk repo ships a first-party simulator for developing and testing Workers, powered by workerd. That gives users a local test environment separate from the deployed edge. The evidence does not say how bindings such as KV, D1 and R2 are isolated from production data, nor does it document preview or staging environments. The Sandbox SDK is about isolating untrusted code execution, not separating test data from production, so it is not credited here. missing for 10: explicit documentation that local or preview bindings keep production data untouched, staging/preview environment docs, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: A simulator for developing and testing Cloudflare Workers, powered by workerd
